title: Worker management MCP tools and operator read models
observed_behavior: Worker command publisher and handlers existed for lifecycle and label commands; MCP lacked signer-first worker command tools and worker operator read models were not exposed as assignment, drain, or eligibility projections.
intended_behavior: Operators and agents can publish signer-first worker management commands and inspect Nostr-backed read models for worker assignment state, drain status, and eligibility previews without frontend changes.
